[[Yahya]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[Non-player character|NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for [[armor]].

== Locations ==
* [[Istan]]
** {{NPC location|Cliffs of Dohjok}}

== Dialogue ==
: ''"They say there's a number of old copper coins buried on these beaches. They're not worth much as money, but are worth a great deal to me as a collector of old coins. If you should see any, or get any from those terrible [[corsair]]s, I'd gladly trade with you. Find 3 [[Copper Shilling]]s, and I'll give you some of the items I found along the beach in return:"''
{{Nosale dialogue|Copper Shillings}}
